harper_marketing: Quick sync: us-west latency spike affecting streaming responses. Need a short statuspage line, console banner, and rules for who gets the post-incident outreach. Trying to avoid churn — prefer targeted emails only.

noah_sre: We're seeing degraded tail latency on streaming endpoints due to a scheduler regression. Rolling partial rollback now. Recommend: post an "Investigating" line immediately, update at 15m with rollback status, then "Service restored" once rollback completes and latency normalizes for 10m. RCA within 48h.

dani_engineering: I'll push rollback; ETA ~8-12 minutes. Agree on cadence. For public wording, keep it non-technical: affected streaming & chat responses in us-west.

harper_marketing: Draft status blurb candidates please. Console banner text? Also routing: which customers to email vs. DM?

dani_engineering: Status blurb:
```
Investigating: Some users in US-West may experience slow or delayed streaming responses. Engineers are actively rolling back a deployment to restore normal performance. We'll post updates here and on https://status.redwood.ai.
```

noah_sre: Console banner idea:
"US-West streaming delays — investigating. See status.redwood.ai for updates."

ryan_csm: CS plan: Flag accounts with >500k tokens/day or active sessions during the window. Those get a personalized note and offer of a priority ops call. Trials and low-usage customers get an in-product notice only.

tess_sales: For inbound lead routing: mark any demo requests from impacted orgs as priority and alert assigned AE. Also offer Dedicated trial if they need stability for demo.

harper_marketing: Email template (personalized for impacted customers):
```
Subject: Redwood update  US-West streaming delays

Hi <FirstName>,

You may have experienced slower streaming responses from Redwood in the US-West region. We're rolling back a recent deployment and expect normal performance shortly. If this affected your production flows, reply and we'll schedule a priority ops call. Ticket: <TICKET_LINK>.

Thanks for bearing with us,
Redwood Inference Team
```

noah_sre: Confirmed rollback started at 1912345690. Monitor for normal latency and we can switch the status to "Service restored". Do not mention rollback type or internal changelog in public posts.
